items.text: Radiomics of Lung Nodules on Screening CT
The purpose of this study was to evaluate the
stability of radiomic features in a prospective
cohort of 342 patients with indeterminate lung
nodules detected on low-dose CT screening, and
to assess reader agreement across two sites.
All patients underwent thin-section CT with a
was performed semi-automatically by two chest
radiologists blinded to the clinical outcome.
Results showed that 128 of the 342 pulmonary
nodules were malignant on final histopathology.
The mean diameter was 8.4 mm with a range of
4 to 22 mm. First-order texture features achieved
an AUC of 0.87 in the external validation set.
Radiomic features are stable and reproducible
across scanners in lung cancer screening cohorts.
